verdicts.reason: A: the text has no shared left edge. 'WEEKEND ONLY', '20% off', 'Every mixed case.' and the legal line each start at a different x. The Shop Sale button is jammed against the headline and the legal line crowds in underneath it, while a large empty gap separates them from the shoe and the circle, which is cut off at the top and right. B: the text column is aligned and orderly, but reading order is broken. The CTA comes first on the far left, the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, the legal text is too small to read, and the shoe is clipped inside the circle. B is still the cleaner and more intentional layout of the two.
